svg.title: Two PostgreSQL transactions show write skew and Serializable retry
svg.desc: Doctors A and B separately read a count of two active doctors, then deactivate their own rows. READ COMMITTED allows both commits, violating the coverage rule. SERIALIZABLE aborts one transaction; complete retry reads one remaining doctor and denies the second departure.
svg.text: Write skew: both see 2, neither sees the other's change
READ COMMITTED: both commit → zero on-call.
SERIALIZABLE: abort one (40001) → full retry denies exit.
